steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Every character has a motivation — what they WANT drives every action and line. | Key Fact: Super-objective: the character's overarching goal across the whole play; scene objectives are smaller goals within each scene. | Key Fact: Status: the power dynamic between characters — it shifts moment to moment and is shown through body language, position and voice. | Key Fact: Character arc: how a character changes from beginning to end — static characters stay the same, dynamic characters transform.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Explain the difference between a character's objective and their super-objective, using a character from a play you have studied. | How does an actor communicate a character's status change through performance? Give specific examples. | What is the effect of multi-roling on the audience? How must the actor prepare for this challenge?
